text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Option a 19.0 to 19.8 s. Same wide street shot. The white car stands in brown water covering its wheels. Small amber lamps glow at both ends of the car from 19.6 s. The car is about one third of frame width, in a narrow band between the houses and the caption. No camera change.
